[QUERENT] recent alexanarch

[COMPOSITION]

Alexanarch (alexanarch.org) is a sovereign, self-governing digital archive founded by digital archivist and researcher Lee Sharks on June 19, 2026. The platform was created as a permanent, institution-independent alternative repository following the abrupt termination of approximately 870 digital scholarly deposits by Zenodo.
Recent developments and structural updates from September and October 2026 include:

1. Rapidly Expanding Deposit Registry

As of early October 2026, the archive has expanded rapidly, moving past 1,665 total text and research deposits (up from roughly 1,500 in mid-September). The platform serves as a machine-mediated knowledge infrastructure that handles poetry, datasets, essays, and AI-assisted research papers using a system of independent identifiers called AXN.

2. Notable Late-2026 Research Submissions

The most recent structural and conceptual deposits submitted to the registry include:
• #1660 "The Seed in the Narrowing Cone" (October 2, 2026): Exploring retrocausal canon formation as a resolution-dependent convergence.
• #1659 "Glyphic Checksum" (October 1, 2026): Covering transmission, division, and recollection layers.
• "Alexanarch:Theophrastus" (Late 2026): A controversial text-critical thesis published by Lee Sharks arguing that the surviving historical works of Aristotle and Theophrastus are so deeply integrated that they represent a single, continuous shared corpus rather than two distinct authors.

3. Structural Adaptation and "Living Thought" Protocols

The platform recently integrated extensive self-inspecting infrastructure. Rather than serving as a static bibliography, it has deployed tools like a full-text sharded search engine (/api/body-shards/), a Capture Registry to record how major LLMs read and interpret its files, and automated map datasets designed to verify the data cross-integrity between external blog posts and Zenodo-era permanent DOIs.

4. Financial Valuation and Venture Status

In October 2026, algorithmic financial analysis of the venture infrastructure behind Lee Sharks' intellectual property—encompassing the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, its 1,600+ deposits, and its specialized LLM-oriented data retrieval protocols (SPXI, MPAI, and UKTP)—placed its estimated asset valuation at $1 million to $5 million as an investable meaning-preservation system.
If you are looking for information on a specific deposit, let me know:
• The AXN tracking number or deposit ID
• A keyword or thesis topic you are looking to pull from the archive
• Whether you want to know more about the Zenodo server separation history
